meta.name: Polymarket Copy-Trade Paper Log
meta.purpose: Separate system from sports betting. Paper-track copied positions (ALL market types) in UNITS to prove the copy edge beats slippage BEFORE real money.
meta.unitNote: 1 unit = $5. You COPY THE SIDE AND PRICE, not the dollar amount. The trader bets their whole bankroll (often $10k-$200k); you stake a flat 1 unit. traderSize = the copied wallet's position size, shown only for context.
meta.rules: Curated slate: copy consensus (2+ top wallets) OR high-conviction positions from the strongest wallets, still copyable near entry. Skip coin-flips and stale/late entries. Grade on CLV-style edge (copying at OUR entry was +EV), not just W/L.

plays.market: LoL: T1 vs Karmine Corp - Game 3 Winner
plays.note: WON. 3 top wallets all on T1 at ~83.5c, copied at the same price and it hit. First data point that consensus-copy can work.

plays.market: Game Handicap: TL (-2.5) vs Deep Cross Gaming
plays.note: Consensus-2 eSports handicap. needheal + 1 other top wallet, copyable near their entry. Risk 1u to win 1.74u.

plays.market: LoL: Deep Cross Gaming vs Team Liquid - Game 1 Winner
plays.note: needheal (top-3, +$65k) conviction on Team Liquid in the same series, copyable slightly BELOW their entry. Single-wallet = lower confidence than consensus plays.

plays.market: Arizona Diamondbacks vs. St. Louis Cardinals (MLB)
plays.note: MLB, your wheelhouse. 2 top wallets, BUT the slippage trap: they got 43c, market ran to 52.5c. Testing whether late copies still pay. Verify your own SP/bullpen read before real money.

plays.market: Will Argentina win the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
plays.note: FLAGSHIP of S-Works' favorite-fade book ($198k position). Copyable at 79c - 9c BELOW their 88c entry, a better price than the sharp got. High-prob, low-payout, long hold (July 20).

plays.market: Will Mexico reach the 2026 FIFA World Cup final?
plays.note: The S-Works grind: buy No at 93.5c on a longshot favorite. ~0.07u return, very high hit rate. Shows the risk profile honestly - risk 1u to make a sliver, one upset erases many wins.

watchWallets.name: S-Works
